# ADHDme

> Australia’s largest directory of holistic ADHD providers: GPs, psychiatrists, psychologists, allied health clinicians and coaches. Each profile says how the clinician works, where they practise and how their fees work, and you book with the practice directly. ADHDme does not provide health care and takes no commission.

Clinician profiles are written from each clinician's own description of their work. Fees and Medicare details are as each practice publishes them; the practice confirms them when you book.

## Find care

- [Australia’s largest holistic ADHD directory](https://www.adhdme.au/): Australia’s largest directory of holistic, neuroaffirming ADHD providers. GPs, psychiatrists, psychologists, allied health and coaches. No referral needed.
- [Find an ADHD GP, psychologist or coach](https://www.adhdme.au/the-doctors.html): Browse Australia’s largest directory of holistic ADHD providers: GPs, psychiatrists, psychologists, allied health and coaches, many by telehealth.
- [How to find and book an ADHD clinician](https://www.adhdme.au/how-it-works.html): Read how each ADHD clinician works, where they practise and how their fees work, then book or enquire with the practice. No referral needed.
- [ADHD care navigator: who could help?](https://www.adhdme.au/care-navigator.html): Not sure who to see for ADHD? Tap a GP, psychologist, coach or therapist to see what they do, or answer a few quick taps to find your match.

## ADHD care by place and profession

- [ADHD care in Australia by place and profession](https://www.adhdme.au/adhd-services.html): ADHDme guides to ADHD care in Australia by city, by profession and after a diagnosis. Each lists local clinicians, fees and whether you need a referral.
- [ADHD doctor Gold Coast: who to see and costs](https://www.adhdme.au/adhd-doctor-gold-coast.html): ADHD care on the Gold Coast: psychologists in Benowa and Bundall, an exercise physiologist in Bundall, and a GP assessment by phone for $498.
- [ADHD GP Brisbane: diagnosis, medication, costs](https://www.adhdme.au/adhd-gp-brisbane.html): Nine ADHD GPs in Graceville, Brisbane, who diagnose adults and prescribe under Queensland’s 2025 rules. Two psychiatrists, fees, telehealth and booking.
- [ADHD assessment Queensland: three routes, costs](https://www.adhdme.au/adhd-assessment-queensland.html): How ADHD assessment works in Queensland since the December 2025 reform: GP, psychologist or psychiatrist. No referral needed for a GP or psychologist.
- [ADHD assessment Sydney: GP, $498, no referral](https://www.adhdme.au/adhd-assessment-sydney.html): Two GPs assess and diagnose ADHD in Beecroft, Double Bay and Hornsby. $498 across two consultations, no referral needed, with phone and telehealth options.
- [ADHD assessment online: what telehealth can do](https://www.adhdme.au/adhd-assessment-online.html): Get assessed for ADHD by phone or telehealth anywhere in Australia, with no referral. Which parts can be done remotely and which need a clinic visit.
- [ADHD treatment after diagnosis: what happens next](https://www.adhdme.au/adhd-treatment-after-diagnosis.html): After an ADHD diagnosis: medication, therapy, OT and coaching. Who provides each, and how Medicare covers up to 10 psychology sessions a year.
- [ADHD exercise physiologist: benefits and funding](https://www.adhdme.au/adhd-exercise-physiologist.html): How an exercise physiologist helps with ADHD, exercising safely on stimulants, and funding through a GP care plan. In person in Bundall on the Gold Coast.
- [ADHD psychologist: assessment, therapy, costs](https://www.adhdme.au/adhd-psychologist.html): ADHD psychologists assess, diagnose and provide therapy. With a GP’s Mental Health Treatment Plan, Medicare pays $101.55 or $149.05 a session.
- [ADHD psychiatrist Brisbane: fees, telehealth, wait](https://www.adhdme.au/adhd-psychiatrist-brisbane.html): Two psychiatrists in Graceville, Brisbane, who assess ADHD and its overlaps, in person or by telehealth. $900 first consultation, Medicare rebate applies.
- [ADHD psychologist Brisbane: assessment, telehealth](https://www.adhdme.au/adhd-psychologist-brisbane.html): ADHD psychologists in Fortitude Valley, Ashgrove and Graceville, Brisbane. ADHD and autism assessment, therapy and telehealth, from children to adults.
- [ADHD occupational therapist: help with daily life](https://www.adhdme.au/adhd-occupational-therapist.html): How an occupational therapist helps with ADHD routines at home and school, and how OT is funded through the NDIS or a GP plan. Paediatric OT in Brisbane.
- [ADHD coaching in Australia: costs and JobAccess](https://www.adhdme.au/adhd-coach.html): ADHD coaching in Perth, Sutherland and online, what a session costs, and how JobAccess can fund it if you work at least eight hours a week.

## Guides

- [How booking with ADHDme works, no referral needed](https://www.adhdme.au/blog-how-booking-works.html): Browse every clinician without an account, see how fees work on each profile, then book or enquire with the practice. No platform fee or upfront payment.
- [Body doubling for ADHD: a simple focus tool](https://www.adhdme.au/blog-body-doubling.html): Body doubling means working while someone else is nearby. Why it can make starting a task easier for people with ADHD, and how to try it tonight.
- [Adult ADHD diagnosis: what the research says](https://www.adhdme.au/blog-late-diagnosis.html): Diagnosed with ADHD as an adult? What the research says about late diagnosis, why adults are often missed, and what good care looks like afterwards.
- [Just diagnosed with ADHD? What to do next](https://www.adhdme.au/blog-diagnosed-what-now.html): Just diagnosed with ADHD? What to read first, who to see, what medication and therapy involve in Australia, and which decisions can safely wait.
- [ADHD support beyond medication: what works](https://www.adhdme.au/blog-adhd-support-beyond-medication.html): Therapy, occupational therapy, coaching and daily habits for ADHD: what each one helps with, who provides it, what it costs, and how to choose.
- [ADHD and exercise: when, how much, and safety](https://www.adhdme.au/blog-adhd-and-exercise.html): Exercise gives a small, short-lived lift in attention. When to schedule it, what changes if you take stimulants, and how to keep it going for months.
- [ADHD at work in Australia: adjustments and funding](https://www.adhdme.au/blog-adhd-workplace-support.html): Reasonable adjustments for ADHD at work, whether you need to disclose, what Australian law says, and how JobAccess can fund coaching and equipment.
- [ADHD and nutrition: diet, supplements, appetite](https://www.adhdme.au/blog-adhd-nutrition.html): No diet treats ADHD, but stimulants often affect appetite. How to plan meals around that, what the evidence says on supplements, and when to see a GP.
- [ADHD and executive functioning: what helps](https://www.adhdme.au/blog-adhd-executive-functioning.html): Executive function covers starting, planning, finishing, remembering and managing feelings. How ADHD affects it, and the strategies with evidence.

## About

- [School support: talking with your child’s school](https://www.adhdme.au/school-support.html): A clearer way to work with your child’s school after an ADHD diagnosis or assessment. Three steps, what support can look like, and a guide for the meeting.
- [Learn about ADHD: research and resources](https://www.adhdme.au/learn.html): ADHD apps, lessons and resources for patients and parents, including Australia's clinical guideline, a First Nations factsheet and reading clinicians recommend.
- [Our story: why we started ADHDme](https://www.adhdme.au/our-story.html): ADHDme was founded by two medical trainees with ADHD who had very different experiences of care. They built a network that looks beyond symptoms.

## Optional

- [Privacy policy](https://www.adhdme.au/privacy.html): How ADHDme collects, uses and shares information when you use our website and newsletter, and the choices you have about it.
- [Terms of use](https://www.adhdme.au/terms.html): The terms for using ADHDme, a directory of ADHD clinicians in Australia: what the site is, booking with a practice, and your rights under Australian law.
- [Automated decisions](https://www.adhdme.au/automated-decisions.html): How ADHDme uses automation: what runs automatically, what is never automated, and how people oversee the clinician listings and your requests.
